data.name: Regnum Last Sanctum
data.detailed_description:
Enter the dark fantasy World of Regnum, where skill, survival, and progression shape your fate.

Regnum Last Sanctum is a stylized medieval dark fantasy action RPG that begins with Saga I - Combat: Wrath of the Goblins, its opening Saga. Take on the role of the Nordheim hero, protect Regnum's last sanctum, defend fort Nordhold, and defeat the goblin invasion through fast-paced and skill-based combat using unique melee weapons, powerful magic, and deadly arrows.

Earn valuable items, and grow stronger through Soul experience. Death has consequences: each death increases your Malice, and if it rises too high, your character and inventory may be lost permanently — but your Soul experience, Influence and Gold coin remains.

As the first Saga in the world of Regnum Last Sanctum, this journey marks the beginning of a larger vision that will expand over time into sandbox creation, online kingdom PvP, and persistent online play.


Regnum is a world of adventure — waiting for you to forge your destiny.

    Saga I - Combat: Wrath of the Goblins

Available at release

The first playable Saga of Regnum Last Sanctum begins at fort Nordhold in the frost Kingdom of Nordheim.

Reincarnate as the hero of the Nordheim tales and defend fort Nordhold against the goblin invasion. Survive the goblin attack where only skill determines your fate. Outplay clever goblins with melee, magic, and ranged combat. Earn valuable gear. Face enemies that adapt and coordinate, and defeat the end boss, Kolvruk The Goblin Lord, to receive great rewards.

This first Saga focuses on:

  • Fast-paced melee, magic and ranged action combat systems

  • Aggressive and clever goblins - Survive the Easy, Hard and Hardcore modes

  • Soul experience progression, persistent rewards and perma death

  • Nordhold strategic settlement and battlefield (destructible)

  • Kingdom of Nordheim lore

The World of Regnum

Regnum is a dark fantasy world shaped by ancient power, hostile lands, and the growing corruption of the Malice.

From the frosty mountains of Nordheim to the green heartlands of Midland and the burning desert of Sudahra, the world of Regnum is planned to expand through multiple Sagas.

A Game Built Through Sagas

Regnum Last Sanctum grows through multiple Sagas, each introducing a new way to experience the world.

The journey begins with skill-based combat in Saga I, then expands toward sandbox systems, competitive multiplayer strategy, and long-term kingdom warfare. Progression is planned to carry across your journey through Soul EXP, with future rewards including cosmetics, titles, and persistent progression features.

These Sagas are planned for future development and are not available at initial release.

     Saga II - Sandbox: Into the Dungeon — Planned Feature

A singleplayer voxel sandbox experience focused on crafting, building, dungeon exploration, and PvE survival. Players will gather resources, shape the world, build their home, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath Regnum.

    Saga III - Online: Kingdom Wars — Planned Feature

A team match-based Kingdom vs Kingdom multiplayer PvP strategy sandbox. Choose your realm, crown a King, manage your Kingdom, forge weapons, defend your people, and fight through war, ressource strategy, and wisdom.

    Long-Term Vision - Saga IV - Persistent Online World — Planned Future Expansion

The long-term vision for Regnum Last Sanctum is a persistent online multiplayer world where players form kingdoms, forge politics, wage war, and shape the world through kingdom management, strategy, and conquest.

Development Notice

Regnum Last Sanctum is currently in active development. Features and content are subject to change. Saga II, Saga III, and the persistent online world Saga IV are planned future features and are not available at initial release.

data.short_description: Regnum Last Sanctum begins with Saga I — Combat: Wrath of the Goblins. An dark epic, Action RPG, Regnum's Quest to defend its last sanctum against the invading goblins. Master skill-based combat, fight clever foes, and progress in the realm of Regnum where death has consequences. Will you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Designed for low settings at 1080p, 30–60 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: High settings at 1080p–1440p, smooth 60+ FPS

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU (Intel Iris Plus or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Runs via Metal; optimized for Apple Silicon
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or newer
  • Processor: Apple M2
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro series
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Best experience on Apple Silicon devices

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized combat involving goblin enemies, including depictions of blood and dismemberment. Players can defeat enemies using melee, and ranged weapons, resulting in body parts detaching such as limbs or heads. The violence is presented in a stylized, non-realistic manner within a fantasy setting.
